verdict.rationale: Attio's per-endpoint REST reference pages render a live "Try it" API playground, so each documented endpoint can be run in the browser. The reference is backed by a public OpenAPI 3.1 specification served at api.attio.com. The probe's 404s at docs.attio.com paths do not contradict this, because the spec is documented at a different host. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the playground executes requests, and explicit evidence of per-endpoint code samples in multiple languages beyond the Try-it runner.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: render a live "Try it" API playground (the Mintlify api.playground runtime), so each documented endpoint can be exercised in-browser
